description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'exclude_patterns' functionality within a Git-related project. It contains setup routines, test cases, and assertions to verify behavior of ref store exclusions and pattern matching mechanisms.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs 'test-tool ref-store' with exclude patterns on references, saves output to 'actual.raw', and cuts the second column for comparison.

methods.name: for_each_ref
methods.description: Runs 'git for-each-ref' with given arguments and formats output to list reference names.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks if specific jump patterns are present in trace output based on ref format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Asserts that no jump patterns are present in trace output.
